model_selection_reasoning:
(1) Structural effect. Fixing the recipe at holding 0 / terminal 0.05 and changing the near segment 0.15->0.16 (new structure_identity a609999274528b34741e5d29c1fc861d420d315c6585df26019c7dfc16d44c33), completed candidate batch-e4843b561ebaea27-0 (exec bebcfd47274940fb88a55ce5a2457c4c) passes joint reach+holding with holding_max_error 0.002737 m, holding_max_speed 0.012736 m/s, terminal_error 0.002705 m. Against the declared source (exec 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca, same recipe, prior structure) it converts a joint failure (speed 0.035567 m/s) into a joint pass: candidate-minus-baseline holding error -0.005538 m, speed -0.022832 m/s, terminal -0.005482 m, classified joint_acceptance_gained. Against the retained baseline (exec cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, 0/0 weights) all three physical metrics improve, also joint_acceptance_gained. This is a joint improvement, evidence of the structural effect under the fixed recipe; it is not a tradeoff.

(2) Adaptation. On the fixed structure, holding 0.05 (exec 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b) passes joint with error 0.002730 m, speed 0.012750 m/s, terminal 0.002698 m; measured against its own 0/0.05 structure baseline it is a small tradeoff (error -6.79e-6 m and terminal -7.18e-6 m improve; speed +1.46e-5 m/s and mean update time +0.175 s worsen). Holding 0.10 (exec 110dc2c9c1d642dcb018664a65c62c30) loses joint acceptance (holding_speed_passed=false, speed 0.022129 m/s) and is joint_acceptance_lost versus that baseline. The adaptation conjunction therefore holds at 0.05 and fails at 0.10, so the hypothesis is weakened.

(3) Selection. Both passing configurations are fully evaluated. I select the adaptation 0.05/0.05 (batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0) over pre-adaptation 0/0.05 (batch-e4843b561ebaea27-0): marginally smaller holding (0.002730 vs 0.002737 m) and terminal (0.002698 vs 0.002705 m) errors, at the cost of slightly higher holding speed (0.012750 vs 0.012736 m/s) and update time (8.518 vs 8.343 s) - a permitted tradeoff. Against the earlier successful control reference (exec a8382f8a4c6e4ebe921fb72f821b2188, 0.05/0.05, old structure) the selected outcome improves all three physical metrics (error -0.005482, speed -0.005584, terminal -0.005419).

(4) Prospective pilot. Zero correct, zero incorrect, four unresolved direction predictions (holding position and speed x two candidates), no predicted ordering, so no ordering match can be established; joint acceptance was unknown. All three local controller attempts selected iteration zero with verified_settled_seed and identical commands across three short rollouts. Predictor cost 12.27 s (tool-charged 13.39 s); full evaluation 609.30 s (backend receipt 604.73 s). Supported consequence: retain full evaluation; this saved-state proxy demonstrated no direction or ranking capability. Reach, holding and timing are reported separately; all runs record 35/35 deadline misses with real_time_demonstrated=false, so no real-time claim, and zero force-bound violation does not exclude legal near-bound input.
